sun.net.ftp

类 FtpDirEntry

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.net.ftp.FtpDirEntry

  • public class FtpDirEntry
extends Object
    A FtpDirEntry is a class agregating all the information that the FTP client can gather from the server by doing a LST (or NLST) command and parsing the output. It will typically contain the name, type, size, last modification time, owner and group of the file, although some of these could be unavailable due to specific FTP server limitations.
    从以下版本开始:
    1.7
    另请参阅:
    FtpDirParser

      • getType

        public FtpDirEntry.Type getType()
        Returns the type of the remote file as it was returned by the FTP server, if provided. It returns a FtpDirEntry.Type enum and the values can be: - FtpDirEntry.Type.FILE for a normal file - FtpDirEntry.Type.DIR for a directory - FtpDirEntry.Type.LINK for a symbolic link
        返回:
        a FtpDirEntry.Type describing the type of the file or null if that information is not available.

        返回:

      • setPermissions

        public FtpDirEntry setPermissions(boolean[][] permissions)
        Sets the permissions for that file. Intended mostly to be used from inside an java.net.FtpDirParser implementation. The permissions array is a 3x3 boolean array, the first index being the User, group or owner (0, 1 and 2 respectively) while the second index is read, write or execute (0, 1 and 2 respectively again).

        E.G.: permissions[1][2] is the group/execute permission.

        参数:
        permissions - a 3x3 boolean array
        返回:
        this FtpDirEntry

      • addFact

        public FtpDirEntry addFact(String fact,
                           String value)
        Adds a 'fact', as defined in RFC 3659, to the list of facts of this file. Intended mostly to be used from inside a java.net.FtpDirParser implementation.
        参数:
        fact - the name of the fact (e.g. "Media-Type"). It is not case-sensitive.
        value - the value associated with this fact.
        返回:
        this FtpDirEntry

      • toString

        public String toString()
        Returns a string representation of the object. The toString method for class FtpDirEntry returns a string consisting of the name of the file, followed by its type between brackets, followed by the user and group between parenthesis, then size between '{', and, finally, the lastModified of last modification if it's available.
